summary: The last build stage of Phase 1. Merged the measure stage (sw.js v9, both ledger sections). Rebuilt the record's L34 (plain Send checklist with a Fix per item, Request approval, price_approvals with RLS, /api/approvals, the owner's queue on /estimates, an approved exact price can be sent), L35 (a signed estimate answers 'locked' before the version check; the phone shows Signed, read-only, 'Your unsent change was not applied.'), L36 (getSessionState ok | signed_out | unreachable, /unreachable, APIs 503, the field app opens from the phone with 'Can't reach Koala right now', next= same-site only), L38 (code banner from the data, crawlspace placeholder R-19, no franchise words in the photo-read prompt), L10 (Target net margin (after overhead) with a live gross-margin preview, stored value unchanged), L11 (material typical_min/typical_max/typical_source, half to twice the cost; a cost far outside refused until 'This cost is right'), sw.js v10. The Business profile nav item was already there (quotes stage). Found and fixed L23c: seed 99999 reported one qty_below_stated_r from floating-point noise exactly on the 0.05 rounding boundary (checker only, rule unchanged). No price formula changed: both golden sets' option totals and the random quotes price exactly as after the quotes stage. Final checks all pass; every invariant is 0 at seed 20261118 (10,000) and seeds 7 and 99999 (20,000 each); origin/main's own e2e passes with only the accuracy migration added (225 ok, the same as without it). Before/after report: 121 differences, 0 unexplained.

Approvals are checked on the phone only when it is online (the Send step loads them); sending needs a connection anyway.
An approval binds the model price as well as the price (beyond the record): if pricing changes between the approval and the send, the estimator asks again.
The office can approve prices beyond an estimator's range but not below the floor margin, and cannot decline a below-floor request either (the decide policy covers both); the owner decides those.
The office still cannot save the business profile (owner-only RLS on app_settings, from the quotes stage); the Send checklist's business-profile Fix is shown to owner and office and opens the page.
